title: Antonio and Tapas 10/10
text: Antonio was an incredible chef and host. We made really good food and learned a lot about cooking tapas and cooking in general. We loved our class and would do it again!
author: Madison_D

title: Cooking with family
text: very relaxed class.  Anyone can do the class.  Included a trip to the market.  The food was excellent.  the school sent all the recipes.
author: DiveBuddy61

title: Amazing
text: This was the most amazing cooking class I’ve ever taken. We take them all over the world when we travel and hands down. This is the best cooking school I’ve ever been to. It is so authentic even though it’s on La Rambla. And Yohannes was the best teacher and most hospitable person I’ve ever met.

title: Top experience

title: Great fun, social and tasty
text: Whole family loved it. Met 2 other families and everyone mixed brilliantly. So much fun. Unexpectedly a highlight of our 10 day trip. Up there with KONG Protocol! Yohannes was super fun and showed us many tips. Do it!!!

title: Educational and delicious
text: We had a wonderful experience. We learned some great culinary tips and the food was uniquely tasty. Johannes was a delight.
author: jamesdweaver11

title: AMAZING experience!
text: My family of four had the best time.  Our chef/guide Yohannes was excellent!  We loved learning about the Boqueria and shopping for the fresh ingredients and then cooking all together was a blast.  The food from start to finish was DELICIOUS!
author: LaurenF529

title: a delightful cooking class in barcelona
text:
I learned a lot from Chef Juan. It was a pleasant cooking experience and market visit to the Boqueria market. Lots of hands on time, and we made a delicious soup, crema
Catalan, tortilla, pan con tomate, and a seafood paella.  I may not eat for a week!
The only difficulty was the link for the location stared with 2 ppl, which indicates second floor, and Mr google and Ms apple maps thought the address was 2 La Rambla instead of 58.
author: crobbmd

title: Don’t hesitate, book it!
text:
OMG, what an amazing cooking class.  Chef Juan really made the class fun (he is a very jovial, well skilled cooking instructor), who has a passion for cooking and teaching. We started off by shopping for the ingredients for our cooking lesson at the amazing Boqueria Market. The sites, colors, and smells of the market were all tantalizing.

After the market, we went back to the cooking school and prepared: Spanish omelettes  (potatoes, onion & egg), gazpacho, tomato bread, seafood paella & flan. Some of the best food we have ever tasted! Jazz played in the background, and the wine flowed (both
author: puchetapola

title: Great experience with Sonia - highly recommend!
text: What a great cooking class! I opted for the Boqueria tour and class. Sonia was fantastic. She helped me navigate the market and provided some great tips and information regarding local ingredients and customs. Then the cooking class was so much fun and had a great pace to it. The instructions were easy and the recipes were delicious. It was very interactive and fun. I had such a wonderful time at my Barcelona cooking class and can’t wait to return with my daughter and take more classes with Sonia. She was fantastic. Thank you for such a wonderful experience during my time in Barcelona!
author: lanamD9749YG
